item.title: Distributor Collaboration and Support Overview
item.description:
Distributor and Agent Partnership: Key Information
#

How does YOHO ensure the stability of product supply?
#

YOHO maintains strict control over in-house safety inventory levels to guarantee a consistent supply of raw materials. Once a contract is finalized, a detailed production plan and delivery schedule are provided to serve as the foundation for production arrangements. Distributors also have the option to negotiate an inventory stocking mechanism with YOHO to address unexpected demand surges.
